01 / About

Behind the terminal

I'm a backend engineer at HCLTech, where I design and ship production systems for global clients like Danfoss and Solventum — from MES/IoT APIs ingesting live plant-floor telemetry to autoscaled microservices on AWS EKS.

My happy place is the invisible layer: graph traversals, event streams, caching strategies, and pipelines that keep data moving fast and reliably. When things break at 2 AM, I'm the person who wants the page.

Outside work I'm deep in DSA (500+ problems on LeetCode & GeeksforGeeks) and competitive programming — ranked #1148 of 90K+ at the Innovate India Coding Championship. I also co-authored an IEEE paper on multi-objective image segmentation (ICCCNT 2023).
